title: Common security questions for Everyone Pay
summary: This document covers Everyone Pay security practices: contact verification before the first transaction, steps to reduce wrong-person payments (saved contacts, review the final confirmation screen, and use verified indicators), how Rho risk checks/monitoring may pause transactions for review, and what to do if fraud is suspected (cancel pending eligible payments, report from transaction details with info, and optionally block the user).
faqs: Do I need to verify contacts before sending a payment?
How can I reduce the risk of sending to the wrong person in Everyone Pay?
How does Rho handle suspicious or unusual activity?
What should I do if I suspect fraud on a payment?
Can I cancel a payment if I suspect fraud?
Should I block a user if I suspect fraud?
keywords: transactions may be paused for review
